{{Term/Store|Aquamentus|Aquamentus|Series, TLoZ, OoS, TLoZ (TV Series)}} is a recurring [[Boss]] in {{TLoZ Series}}.<ref>{{Cite Book|quote= |book= E |publisher= |page= 163 {{Exp Game|TLoZ, OoS}}}}</ref><ref name="TLoZ 1 08">{{Cite Episode|quote= Zelda! Help! This monstrous Aquamentus wants me for lunch! |name= [[Link]] |show= The Legend of Zelda |episode= 8}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|Defeat {{Color NWCNES|Green|Aquamentus}}.|Speedrun Mode|NWCNES}}</ref>{{Name Ref|BSTLoZ}} Aquamentus goes unnamed in the {{OoS (Himekawa)}}.

==Characteristics==
==={{TLoZ|-}}===
{{Descriptions TLoZ}}
In {{TLoZ}}, Aquamentus appears as the [[Boss]] of [[Level 1]] and [[Level 7]] of the First Quest as well as Level-1 of the [[Second Quest]]. It is a [[dragon]] with a horn on its head that some call a unicorn.<ref>{{Cite Manual|quote= A type of dragon that some call a unicorn.|game= TLoZ|page= 37}}</ref> Aquamentus guards a fragment of the [[Triforce of Wisdom]]. More also appear in [[Level 4]] and [[Level 8]] of the Second Quest. Aquamentus slowly walks back and forth and periodically shoots a group of three fireballs out of its mouth.<ref>{{Cite Manual|quote= Aquamentus: A Unicorn having lots of attacking power. It emits beams.|game= TLoZ|page= 37}}</ref> [[Link]] can block the fireballs with a [[Magical Shield]]. Link can damage an Aquamentus with his [[Sword]] or [[Bomb]]s, but can also attack from a distance by throwing his Sword, shooting the [[Bow]] and [[Arrow]] or using the [[Magical Rod]]. Aquamentus cannot be stunned by the [[Boomerang]] and is invulnerable to [[Fire]]. When it is defeated, a [[Heart Container]] will appear and Aquamentus may drop either a [[Heart]], a [[Fairy]], or one [[Rupee]].{{TLoZ Enemy Note}}

==={{OoS|-}}===
[[File:OoS Aquamentus Sprite 2.png|left|54px]]
In {{OoS}}, Aquamentus is the Boss of the first [[Dungeon]], [[Gnarled Root Dungeon]], a Dungeon that resembles Level-1 from {{TLoZ|-}}.<ref>{{Cite Guide|OoS Nintendo|page= 19}}</ref> In addition to its attacks from ''The Legend of Zelda'', Aquamentus now has the ability to charge across the room. After dashing and slamming into the wall, the Aquamentus flies back to the right side of the room. Before emitting beams, its horn will glow. Upon the dragon's defeat, Link receives a Heart Container and the first [[Essence of Nature]], [[Fertile Soil]].

==Other Appearances==
==={{TLoZ|-}} TV Series===
{{Noncanon|Start}}
[[File:Aquamentus (Underworld Connections).png|thumb|right|200px|An Aquamentus from the {{TLoZ|-}} TV series]]
An Aquamentus is depicted as a horse-like monster in the "[[Underworld Connections]]" episode of {{TLoZ (TV Series)}}. As Link is retrieving a shard of the [[Triforce of Wisdom]] while swimming in the [[Black Falls]], an Aquamentus appears out of a dark, underwater cave. The Aquamentus takes him to the surface while Link is riding on top of it, struggling.<ref name="TLoZ 1 08"/> [[Princess Zelda]] then grabs a Bomb from Link's pouch and throws it at the Aquamentus, which instantly defeats it.<ref>{{Cite Episode|quote=Bombs away!|name=Princess Zelda|show=The Legend of Zelda|episode=8}}</ref>
{{Noncanon|End}}

==={{BSTLoZ|-}}===
{{Noncanon|Start}}
[[File:BSTLoZ Aquamentus Green Sprite.png|left|60px]]
Aquamentus appears as the Boss of [[Level 1|Level-1]] and [[Level 7]], and as a Mini-Boss in [[Level 8|Level-8]], in {{BSTLoZ}}. It is fought in the same manner as in {{TLoZ|-}}. In its latter two appearances, Aquamentus is much stronger and more animated, shooting fireballs more frequently and requiring several hits before turning blue, then finally turning red after several more hits, before being defeated.
{{Clear}}
{{Noncanon|End}}

==={{OoS|-}} (Himekawa)===
{{Noncanon|Start}}
An Aquamentus makes an appearance in the {{OoS (Himekawa)}} alongside various other enemies and Bosses from the game. They swarm all at once with the Aquamentus leading the charge, while [[Ricky]] attempts to protect Link by putting him in his pouch and attacking with Tornado Punches. The Aquamentus breaths fire and while Ricky attempts to block the flames with his tornadoes, he is overwhelmed and defeated. It would have been a lost battle if it was not for the appearance of [[Moosh]], who awakes from hibernation at just the right moment to give them a ride to safety at extremely high speed.
{{Noncanon|End}}

==={{Super Mario Maker 2|-}}===
{{Noncanon|Start}}
Aquamentus makes a cameo in {{Super Mario Maker 2}} as of the version update, where its original {{TLoZ}} sprite flashes on-screen when the mini-boss trigger is activated while under the effects of the {{Smw|Master Sword}}.
{{Noncanon|End}}

==={{NWCNES|-}}===
{{Noncanon|Start}}
{{Stub|NWCNES}}
Defeating Aquamentus is the objective of the [[Challenge]] "[[Aquamentus Argumentus]]".
{{Noncanon|End}}

==Trivia==
* In {{BotW}} and {{TotK}}, the [[Aquame Bridge]], [[Aquame Lake]], and the [[Aquame Lake Well]] are all named after Aquamentus.
